original: あいつ……、頑張ってるよなぁ
traducao: He's really working hard, isn't he...

original: ん？\nああ、クレスだよ
traducao: Hm?\nAh, I mean Cress.

original: ここ最近、目に見えて\n剣の腕を上げてきてる
traducao: Lately, his swordsmanship has\nvisibly improved by leaps and bounds.

original: オレも、のんびりしちゃ\nいられないな……
traducao: I can't just sit around taking it easy\neither......

original: ……なあ、折り入って\n頼みがあるんだ
traducao: ...Hey, I have a special favor\nto ask of you.

original: 聞くだけ聞いてくれないか？\n後の判断は、任せるからよ
traducao: Could you at least hear me out?\nI'll leave the decision to you after.

original: クエスト「友としてライバルとして」が\nエントリーされました。\nチェスターから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: Quest 'As a Friend, as a Rival'\nhas been registered.\nYou can accept it from Chester.

original: 付き合わせて悪いな
traducao: Sorry for dragging you along.

original: でも、お前なら\n受けてくれるって気がしてたぜ。\n何となく、だけどな
traducao: Still, I had a feeling you'd accept.\nJust a hunch,\nof course.

original: さ、行こうぜ！
traducao: Come on, let's go!

original: さて、と……。\nここからは気を引き締めて\nかからないとな
traducao: Well now...\nFrom here on, we need to stay sharp\nand stay focused.

original: よろしく頼むぜ、○○
traducao: I'm counting on you, ○○!

original: ふう……。\nこれであと半分、だな
traducao: Whew...\nThat leaves half of them to go, huh.

original: なあ……。\nお前には、背中を預けられる\n親友っているか？
traducao: Hey...\nDo you have a best friend you can trust\nwith your back?

original: って、悪い。\nお前には過去の記憶が\nないんだったな……
traducao: Wait, my bad.\nYou don't have memories of your past,\ndo you......

original: ……クレスとはさ。\nガキの頃からずっと、\n腕を競い合ってきた仲なんだ
traducao: ...Cress and I have been rivals\ncompeting against each other\never since we were kids.

original: 剣と弓の違いはあっても、な
traducao: Even with the difference of sword and bow.

original: だから、わかるんだよ。\nあいつはこのギルドへ来て、変わった
traducao: That's why I can tell.\nComing to this Guild has changed him.

original: 単なる技術だけじゃない。\n目的を見つけて……どんどん強く\nたくましくなっている
traducao: Not just in skill alone.\nFinding purpose... he keeps growing\nstronger and tougher.

original: 何だか……焦っちまうんだよな
traducao: Somehow... it makes me impatient.

original: オレは、あいつとは対等でいたいんだ。\nいざって時に、当たり前にお互いを\n頼れる関係っていうかさ
traducao: I want to be equals with him.\nBeing able to naturally rely on each other\nin a crisis, you know?

original: ……こ、この話は\nクレスには言うなよ！
traducao: ...D-Don't you dare\ntell Cress about this!

original: ほら、残り半分。\nさっさと片付けちまおうぜ！
traducao: Come on, half left to go.\nLet's get it cleaned up quickly!

original: 今ので全部だな。\n助かったよ、○○
traducao: That was the last of them.\nThanks for the help, ○○!

original: クレスもだけど、お前の腕も\nなかなかのもんだよな
traducao: Cress aside, your skills are\npretty impressive too.

original: おかげで色々\n気付けたもんがあったよ
traducao: Thanks to you,\nI realized quite a few things.

original: へへっ。\nありがとな
traducao: Heheh.\nThanks a lot.

original: ふ〜っ。\nようやく、帰ってこれたな
traducao: Whew~\nFinally made it back, huh.

original: なぁ、○○。\nお前も困った事があったら\nいつでも声をかけてくれよ
traducao: Hey, ○○.\nIf you're ever in trouble too,\njust give me a shout anytime.

original: 今度はオレが、お前の力に\nなってやるぜ！
traducao: Next time, I'll be the one\nlending you a hand!

original: じゃあな
traducao: See ya.
